input.answer: StatCan's quarterly population estimates put British Columbia at 5,710,598 people on July 1, 2026 (reference period 2026-07, table 17-10-0009, vector 3, scalar factor "units", so no scaling needed). For context, the previous quarterly estimates in the same table were 5,703,683 (April 1, 2026) and 5,706,331 (January 1, 2026). That is an increase of 6,915 from April to July (5,710,598 − 5,703,683), or about 0.1%. Note that the table's quarterly reference dates are the first day of each quarter, so 2026-07 corresponds to the July 1 estimate you asked about.

answer_values.description: British Columbia population estimate, July 1, 2026 (quarterly population estimates)
